title: Hospital Debts and Suppliers, 2012–2023
grammar: Recap: cause and result with emiatt and aminek következtében
goal: I can describe the takeover of hospitals by the state in 2012 and the hospitals' debts to suppliers (*tartozás, beszállító, számla*).
I can link a cause and its result with *emiatt* and *aminek következtében* (*a kórházak tartoztak, és emiatt a beszállítók tiltakoztak*).
I can say what was reported and what was disputed about the debts.
